ctaHeading: Ready for Custom Joinery? Let's Talk.
aboutText: L&K Joinery, based in Sunshine North, Victoria, is a leading name in cabinet making and joinery. We specialise in designing, manufacturing, and installing a wide range of custom furniture and fixtures, including cabinets, wardrobes, bathroom vanities, and TV entertainment units. Our team is committed to professionalism and customer satisfaction, serving both residential and commercial clients across Victoria. With a focus on quality craftsmanship and attention to detail, we ensure every project is tailored to meet your specific needs and exceed expectations.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of joinery services, from custom cabinetry to complete bathroom solutions. Each project is handled with precision, using high-quality materials to create beautiful and functional pieces for your Sunshine North home or business. Our expertise extends to both residential and commercial sectors, ensuring versatile solutions for every requirement.

services.title: Custom Cabinets
services.desc: We design and build custom cabinets tailored to your kitchen, laundry, or living space, ensuring a perfect fit and high-quality finish.

services.title: Wardrobe Installation
services.desc: We offer expert installation of custom wardrobes designed for optimal storage and style, all crafted by our skilled team in Sunshine North.

services.title: Bathroom Vanities
services.desc: Create your dream bathroom with our custom vanities, made from durable materials and designed for elegance and functionality.

services.title: TV Entertainment Units
services.desc: We design and build modern TV units and entertainment centres that complement your living room and meet your media needs.

services.title: Custom Furniture
services.desc: We craft bespoke furniture pieces such as dining tables, desks, and shelving units, all built to your exact specifications.

services.title: Commercial Joinery
services.desc: We provide specialised joinery for businesses, including shop fit-outs, office furniture, and commercial cabinetry solutions tailored to your needs.
